intro.line: lookout: review, fix, test, and review again.

items: Groups that say why, and the plan's map.

shots.label: lookout open
shots.title: Scored before any reviewer
shots.line: lookout ranks every changed file the moment the review opens.

shots.label: Risk
shots.line: Files in risk bands. Related files form groups, each saying why it belongs together.

shots.label: System-1
shots.line: Half of each file's risk is Jev's judgment: how likely this change breaks something, and how badly.

shots.label: Signals
shots.line: The other half is signals: what the path is (auth, migration, route) and how much changed.

shots.label: Grouping
shots.line: Groups come from imports, tests, shared folders and findings, six files at most.

shots.label: Map view
shots.line: Give it a plan's map, and the Map view holds the plan against the diff: one planned test was never written.

shots.label: The loop
shots.title: One prompt
shots.line: Fresh reviewer, fix, run the tests, re-open. Until a round comes back clean.

shots.label: Round 1
shots.title: Six findings, fixed
shots.line: The agent fixes each one, runs npm test, commits, and marks it addressed with what changed.

shots.label: Round 2
shots.title: A fresh reviewer
shots.line: It reads the fixed code and skips what was already filed. Three new findings.

shots.label: Round 3
shots.title: Two more, then the cap
shots.line: Two new findings. The loop stops after three rounds.

shots.label: Back and forth
shots.line: Each finding keeps its failure scenario and the agent's note on what it changed.

shots.label: You
shots.title: You close the fixes
shots.line: Only a person closes a finding. The gate counts down as you do.

shots.label: lookout gate
shots.line: The gate passes, and the agent says what nobody re-reviewed: round 3's fixes.
